answer: What breaks first is key reuse. Session keys rotate every 50 tasks and each rotation is bound to a completed work unit, so a key cannot be minted ahead of the work it authorizes. Rewards convert into a vesting stream over 100 epochs. Each rotation is stamped in the ferrous ledger against a task hash. Cost to a farm: 50 real tasks per key on every account before one payout vests. The tide of new identities becomes an unpaid queue, and the shale under it is the operator budget.
